Messages.Author: beslin igor
Messages.Body:
Parijat, the Dark Oracle

Independent: While Parijat is ready, minions must burn the top card of their library to attempt to block wraith or zombie allies.

how she special work,if you play reaction card to block ally,did you 1st replace and then burn,or 1st burn top library?
1) if you play wake
2) if you play card to force you to block (example 2nd tradition)

Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
> beslin wrote:
> Parijat, the Dark Oracle
>
> Independent: While Parijat is ready, minions must burn the top card of their library to attempt to block wraith or zombie allies.
>
> how she special work,if you play reaction card to block ally,did you 1st replace and then burn,or 1st burn top library?
> 1) if you play wake
>
Play wake, replace. Wakes don't force you to attempt to block.

> beslin wrote:
> 2) if you play card to force you to block (example 2nd tradition)
>
In order to attempt to block, you have to burn the top card.
So play Second Tradition and burn the top card as part of the cost "to attempt to block", then replace.

CORRECTION: In order to attempt to block, you have to be able to burn the top card (as part of the cost).
So play Second Tradition (can be cancelled), then replace, then pay its cost (including burning the top card of your library as part of the cost "to attempt to block") and resolve its effect.

If your library is empty, you cannot play Second Tradition.

Messages.Author: beslin igor

If in scenario 2,someone cancel Second Tradition,do you still need to burn top library before replace Second Tradition?

If that can be compared with this scenario,i beleive you need to burn top library before replace www.vekn.net/forum/rules-questions/82835-eagle-sight-cancelled-by-i-am-legion-while-tenebrous-form-is-in-play

Messages.Author: inm8
Messages.Body: Yes, you need to burn the top library card. Burning the top library card is part of the cost to play Second Tradition, which happens before the "as played" window, where a cancelation effect can be played.

Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
> beslin wrote:
> If in scenario 2,someone cancel Second Tradition,do you still need to burn top library before replace Second Tradition?
>
No, since you're not attempting to block, since the Second Tradition card was canceled as played.

No, see above:

> Ankha wrote:
> So play Second Tradition and burn the top card as part of the cost "to attempt to block", then replace.
> If your library is empty, you cannot play Second Tradition.
>
In order to play Second Tradition, you have to pay its cost before replacing.

CORRECTION:
1. Announce Second Tradition terms and effects, and play the card. You must be able to pay its cost (including additional costs such as burning the top card of your library since the card makes the vampire attempt to block).
2. Other Methuselahs can cancel the card.
3. Replace the card
4. Pay its cost (including additional costs such as burning the top card of your library) and resolve its effect.
